results.snippet: The United States has placed 11 African countries under its highest level 4 travel advisory, warning American citizens against visiting destinations facing serious security threats ranging from terrorism and kidnapping to armed conflict, civil unrest and inadequate healthcare. * The US has issued its highest Level 4 'Do not travel' advisory for 11 African countries due to serious security risks. *
